{{Quote|Pocket's a lot of fun. I sometimes try to convince people that they have animals in their pockets, too.|Wynn Dorvan|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Pocket''' was the name given to a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[chitlik]] owned by [[Wynn Dorvan]], personal assistant of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]]. Though not completely in love with the animal, Dorvan did show signs of affection for it since it was his only family.
